body.taskEn: TOEFL Academic Discussion. Professor: "Should large cities ban private cars from their centres?" Student A (Lena): "Yes — it would dramatically reduce air pollution." Student B (Omar): "No — it would hurt small businesses that depend on customers who drive." State your opinion and add a new argument.
hints: While Lena focuses on pollution, I think an equally important factor is...

Another benefit that no one has mentioned is...
Of course, such a ban would only work if...
In my view, the advantages clearly outweigh...

task.tr: TOEFL Akademik Tartışma görevi. Profesör soruyor: "Notlar öğrencileri öğrenmeye motive eder mi, yoksa sadece not almaya mı?" Görüşünüzü örneklerle destekleyin ve tartışmaya katkı sağlayın.

task.ru: Задание TOEFL Academic Discussion. Профессор спрашивает: «Мотивируют ли оценки студентов учиться — или только получать оценки?» Подкрепите своё мнение примерами и внесите вклад в дискуссию.

body.taskEn: TOEFL Academic Discussion. Professor: "Do grades motivate students to learn, or only to get good grades?" Student A (Kenji): "Grades give clear goals and keep students working." Student B (Sara): "Grades make students memorise instead of understand." State your opinion and contribute to the discussion.
hints: Both Kenji and Sara make valid points, but I lean towards...

topic: Integrated writing: the four-day work week
title: Integrated Writing: The Four-Day Week

task.tr: TOEFL Entegre Yazma görevi. Okuma parçası dört günlük çalışma haftasının verimliliği artırdığını savunuyor; dinleme kısmında ise bir profesör bu iddialara itiraz ediyor. Profesörün argümanlarının okuma parçasındaki noktalara nasıl karşı çıktığını özetleyin. Kendi görüşünüzü yazmayın.
task.tk: TOEFL Integrirlenen ýazuw ýumuşy. Okalýan tekst dört günlük iş hepdesiniň öndürijiligi ýokarlandyrýandygyny öňe sürýär; diňleme böleginde bolsa bir professor bu pikirlere garşy çykýar. task.ru: Задание TOEFL Integrated Writing. В тексте утверждается, что четырёхдневная рабочая неделя повышает производительность; в лекции профессор оспаривает эти утверждения. Кратко изложите, как аргументы профессора опровергают пункты текста. Не пишите своё мнение.

body.taskEn: TOEFL Integrated Writing. READING: A four-day week (1) raises productivity because rested workers focus better, (2) cuts costs such as electricity, and (3) helps companies attract talent. LECTURE: The professor argues that (1) productivity gains in trials faded after a year, (2) savings were offset by overtime and customer-service gaps, and (3) once many firms adopt it, it no longer gives an advantage in hiring. Summarise how the lecture challenges each point in the reading.
hints: The reading claims that...; however, the professor casts doubt on this by...
First, regarding productivity, the lecturer points out that...
Second, the professor challenges the claim about costs, explaining that...
Finally, the reading's argument about attracting talent is undermined because...
In short, the lecture suggests that the benefits are...

topic: Integrated writing: the decline of honeybees
title: Integrated Writing: Why Are Bees Disappearing?

task.tr: TOEFL Entegre Yazma görevi. Okuma parçası arı nüfusundaki azalma için üç açıklama sunuyor; profesör her birini zayıflatıyor. Dersin okuma parçasıyla nasıl çeliştiğini özetleyin.

body.taskEn: TOEFL Integrated Writing. READING: Honeybee decline is caused by (1) mobile-phone radiation, (2) a single new pesticide, and (3) cold winters. title: Academic Discussion: Is Space Worth the Money?
